summary: All three files are authored ACL2 source files containing formal mathematical definitions and theorems about array operations. aset1-safe.lisp defines a bounds-checked array setter and proves its equivalence to aset1. compress1.lisp proves numerous properties of the built-in compress1 function (header, dimensions, alistp, array1p, aref1 behavior). typed-acl2-arrays.lisp provides macros (def-array-checker, def-typed-acl2-array, def-typed-acl2-array2) that generate typed array predicates with extensive theorem suites about preservation under aset1, compress1, expand-array, and new-array1. None are build artifacts, pure imports, or sidecars — all contain searchable formal mathematics.
